notes.title: European Spanish Translation!
notes.content: Thanks to the amazing work of Adrián P. del Moral and Wyros, Fatum Betula now has a fully complete European Spanish translation that you can access via the game's launch menu.

notes.title: Optional Dithering Disabled Branch
notes.content: There is now an optional beta branch that disables the in game dithering for those who were experiencing graphics card related visual bugs.

PATCH NOTES:
- Fixed bug in which players couldn't save properly after experiencing an ending.

notes.title: Update 1.16 - Epilepsy Friendly Option!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568542/40c9e3c2ffb2e11a68fde2468efc971a145ae842.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37568542/f66f3d3110dabb03d2e62b35653958f3905e3658.png[/img]

This update adds a new option to toggle "Epilepsy  Friendly Visuals" on or off.
This option most obviously effects the CherryNightmare area, but it also removes any subtler flashing visuals from several other parts of the game.


PATCH NOTES:
-New Epilepsy Friendly Visuals Option.
